title: Claims Support Specialist
description:
Claims Support Specialist
Location: Remote
About WithCoverage :
WithCoverage replaces the traditional insurance brokerage with AI-supercharged risk management designed for the modern economy.
We partner with hundreds of high-growth, category-defining companies, including GoPuff, Eight Sleep, Bombas, Chomps, and Blank Street Coffee. Our clients span iconic consumer brands, hospitality leaders, GCs, advanced manufacturers, and next-generation defense contractors. They operate in complex risk environments and need a partner that can move at their speed.
Instead of a fragmented, manual brokerage stack, we have built a new category: elite risk advisors operating on top of proprietary technology. Our in-house Agency Management System gives our team and AI agents full visibility into policies, exposures, claims, billing, and commissions. This platform enables deep automation, better decisions, and a fundamentally higher standard of service.
WithCoverage was founded by JD Ross (co-founder of Opendoor) and Max Brenner (Bain, Compound). We have raised over $43M from leading investors including Sequoia, 8VC, Khosla Ventures and Crystal Venture Partners.
Our ambition is not to build a better brokerage. It is to redefine how risk is managed across the economy.
Why Join Us:

•
Grow Faster - We’re scaling quickly, giving you significant opportunities to learn, lead, and shape your career and the company's future.

•
Work That Matters - We protect the world’s most innovative brands: consumer icons, hospitality leaders, next-gen defense contractors, and US manufacturers.

•
Redefine an Industry - Insurance is one of the largest, slowest-moving markets. We rewrite the playbook with proprietary technology, automation, and AI.

•
Financial Rewards - We hire the best and invest in you. That means competitive comp, meaningful equity, and excellent benefits. We believe strongly in internal promotion and lay out a plan for everyone's career growth.

About The Role:
As our Claims Specialist, you will be the primary advocate for our clients, ensuring a seamless claims process by providing expert guidance, proactive communication, and strategic claims resolution. You’ll work closely with insurers, adjusters, and internal teams to manage claims efficiently, resolve coverage issues, and optimize outcomes for our clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, tech-enabled environment, has a deep understanding of claims advocacy, and enjoys problem-solving within the evolving landscape of commercial insurance.
What You’ll Do:

• Claims Advocacy & Resolution

• Serve as the main point of contact for clients throughout the claims process, providing clear guidance and updates.

• Evaluate policy coverage and advocate for the best possible outcomes for clients.

• Challenge adjusters when necessary to ensure fair and timely settlements.

• Proactively anticipate and present strategic solutions to clients for resolving claims.

• Claims Management & Communication

• Oversee the full lifecycle of claims, from initial report to final resolution.

• Conduct new business claims audits for newly acquired clients.

• Collaborate with insurers, underwriters, and external adjusters to negotiate claims settlements.

• Facilitate client meetings, claims reviews, and carrier discussions to ensure alignment and transparency.

• Maintain meticulous documentation of claims activity in our proprietary agency management system.

• Client Education & Risk Mitigation

• Educate clients on claims administration, coverage nuances, and proactive risk management.

• Offer guidance on reducing claim exposure and improving policy language to prevent disputes.

• Prepare and deliver quarterly claims reviews with key insights and recommendations.

• Process Optimization & Technology Integration

• Leverage technology to streamline claims handling, improving efficiency and accuracy.

• Partner with product team to identify opportunities to enhance internal claims pro

title: Sports Customer Onboarding Officer (Maternity Cover)
description:
By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before.  Learn more at geniussports.com.

THE ROLE

This role is part of Genius' team that helps sports leagues and teams boost performance on and off the field using cutting-edge tech, analytics, and visual insights. 

We are looking for a Sports Customer Onboarding Officer  to support the rollout of Genius Sports products across leagues and partners. You will onboard new clients, manage technical setups, and ensure smooth delivery of streaming and analytics solutions. This role works closely with both clients and internal teams, requiring strong coordination, product understanding, and the ability to keep operations running efficiently.

This is a temporary role to cover maternity leave.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

• Onboard leagues, federations, and partners onto Genius Sports products.

• Set up and support streaming integrations and the GeniusIQ analytics platform.

• Configure technical setups, manage timelines, and ensure smooth project delivery and handover.

• Deliver product training to internal teams and external clients.

• Work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support, and Commercial teams.

• Maintain accurate documentation and training materials.

• Support seasonal readiness, respond to client requests, and resolve or escalate technical issues.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

• Strong understanding of how sports competitions operate across leagues and formats.

• Experience onboarding users or clients onto technical products or platforms.

• Knowledge of video streaming fundamentals such as codecs, resolution, and delivery protocols.

• Comfortable working with APIs and reading technical documentation.

• Experience using tools such as Jira, Confluence, Slack, and Monday.com

• Strong communication, organization, and multitasking skills.

• Detail-oriented, proactive, and customer-focused approach.

IT WILL BE A BONUS IF YOU HAVE:

• Passion for sports and interest in sports technology.

• Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.

• Curiosity and drive to improve processes and workflows.

The monthly salary for this full-time role ranges from €2,100 to €2,600 gross. This role will also be eligible to take part in Genius Sports Group's benefits plan.

We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location. 

As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports.  

One team, being brave, driving change   

We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius .

Let us know when you apply if you need any assistance during the recruiting process due to a disability.

title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

Staff Data Scientist

We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist with high ownership to work on meaningful challenges at scale.

You spot leverage points others miss: measurement systems that unlock pricing, experimentation infrastructure that multiplies output, causal models that rewrite unit economics. You own these end to end.

We value diverse technical lenses. Whether you are:

- Causal inference specialist: propensity matching, DID, synthetic control, IV estimation. You turn observational chaos into rigorous insight.

- Experimentation architect: designing multi-arm tests, MMM, MTA, uplift modelling. You define statistical rigor.

- Systems thinker: building reward structures, pricing algorithms, ranking functions that balance engagement, conversion, and sustainable ROAS.

- Zero to one builder: taking vague business questions into production data products.

What You'll Own

- Measurement strategy. Design causal frameworks that reveal unit economics, attribution, and intervention impact. Own the gold standard documentation so others ship faster.

- Experimentation infrastructure. Build platforms that enable rapid iteration and define statistical rigor without sacrificing speed.

- High leverage models. Identify and own the models that move unit economics: pricing, ranking, user incentive systems. Partner with engineering to productionize rigorously.

- Technical leadership. Mentor junior data scientists. Set the bar for how we think about causality, measurement, and trade offs. Drive clarity when stakeholders disagree.

- Cross functional influence. Work alongside Product, Engineering, and Leadership to turn data insight into business action.

What We're Looking For

- Proven autonomy. Track record moving unit economics through novel approaches. You own problems end to end.

- Causal thinking. Deep experience with causal inference techniques (propensity matching, DID, synthetic control, IV estimation). You reason about causality, not just fit models.

- Experimentation expertise. Led complex multi-arm experiments and designed or owned MMM, MTA, or uplift modelling systems. You understand type I and type II error costs.

- Production maturity. Built and deployed models in product environments (Gaming, AdTech, user incentive systems preferred). You own metrics, monitoring, and decay.

- Data engineering fluency. Comfortable with modern data stacks (dbt, Airflow, Kubernetes, Terraform). You architect alongside engineering, not just consume.

- Communication and presence. Drive clarity in ambiguous situations. Translate complex analysis into decisions. Bring stakeholders along.

Why Almedia

- Grow at Almedia: profitable from launch, higher revenue per employee than Big Tech.

- Sharp, small team: we keep it small on purpose, every hire raises the bar.

- Equity: every Berlin employee gets a stake.

- Top of market baseline. Deliver outlier impact, earn accordingly.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - El Paso, TX, USA
description:
Remote
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.
What You'll Do

• Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team - from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

• Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.
An Ideal Candidate Should Have

• 5+ years of software engineering experien

title: Software Engineer, Strategic Defense
locationText: Costa Mesa, California, United States; Huntsville +10 more
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Strategic Defense team at Anduril protects the United States and its allies from ballistic, hypersonic, and air-breathing threats. Those threats now arrive in seconds, maneuver mid-flight, and come in volleys designed to overwhelm the legacy systems meant to stop them - so we're building a software-defined command and control layer that can see, decide, and act faster than any human operator could alone. Our team spans autonomy, tracking, simulation and wargaming, hardware, systems engineering, and test and evaluation to build an accredited fire control system fielded rapidly and at scale. We are at the forefront of incubating and maturing AI-native offerings for the integrated air and missile defense domain.

ABOUT THE JOB

This application is for experienced coders with 3+ years of experience who will complete live coding interviews and it does not require active clearance but you must be eligible. 

As a Software Engineer in Strategic Defense, you will write code side-by-side with elite peers to solve a wide variety of problems involving networking, autonomy, systems integration, robotics, and more. You’ll make pragmatic engineering tradeoffs along the way to ensure Anduril products achieve a variety of desired outcomes in ambiguous situations where more is on the line than money or corporate gains. By working hand-in-hand with powerhouse teams in AI, Edge Hardware, Space Solutions, Networking, and Test Engineering you will craft cutting-edge, end-to-end systems that redefine mission success for major strategic capabilities. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Own software solutions that are deployed to customers at the edge of innovation and necessity

• Write code to improve robust C2 products and scale mission capabilities to broaden our impact

• Collaborate across multiple engineering teams to plan, build, and test functionality of complex systems

• Partner with end-users to turn needs into features quickly while balancing user experience and engineering constraints

• Travel 10 - 30% with the team to build, test, and deploy capabilities in the real world where they’re needed most

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 3-8+ years writing production software in languages like C++, Rust, Go, or Python that real users or systems depend on

• You've owned a feature or service end-to-end including design, implementation, deployment, and dealing with it when it breaks

• You've debugged problems in code you didn't write and systems you didn't design

• You can explain technical tradeoffs to people who aren't software engineers (operators, hardware engineers, customers)

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• A desire to work on critical software that has a real-world impact

• Exposure to robotics, distributed systems, networking, or real-time systems

• Experience with mid and upper tier Air Defense Command and Control (C2) programs

• Have worked where software touches physical hardware

• Experience building software solutions involving significant amounts of data processing and analysis

• Degree in a relevant field like Computer Science, Math, or Physics

• Willing to travel up to 20% to Asia Pacific

$166,000 — $220,00

title: Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description:
ClickHouse is hiring its first Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own how we engage, activate, and grow our user base across the entire customer journey. Your mission is to turn signups, trial users, and prospects into pipeline and self-serve MRR through behavior-driven lifecycle programs across email and in-product channels. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role focused on lifecycle and marketing automation. It is not a content, SEO, brand, field, or demand gen role, and it does not include managing a team. You will design the nurture engine that powers both our PLG and sales-led motions. You will build from the ground up, try new marketing strategies, and work with a passionate community of ClickHouse users.

What You Will Be Doing

- Own lifecycle marketing strategy end to end, from signup onboarding through activation, conversion, expansion, and re-engagement, with accountability for trial-to-paid conversion, MQL volume, and influenced pipeline.

- Build behavior-triggered nurture programs that respond to product usage, content engagement, and intent signals, so the right message reaches the right user at the right stage.

- Design and optimize onboarding journeys for ClickHouse Cloud signups, partnering with Growth PMs and the product team to align email touchpoints with in-product experiences and drive activation.

- Run always-on nurture for the sales-led funnel, with segmented streams by persona, use case, and funnel stage that warm prospects for sales and accelerate open opportunities.

- Build and run a testing roadmap across subject lines, send cadence, content formats, and channel mix, using results to improve engagement and conversion.

- Report on lifecycle funnel metrics for PLG and SLG, analyze conversion at each stage, identify drop-off points, and implement improvements.

- Track industry trends, competitor activity, and emerging technologies to identify new lifecycle opportunities.

What You Bring

- 6+ years owning lifecycle, email, or growth marketing programs (onboarding, activation, nurture, retention). Years can be combined across roles.

- At least 3 years at a database, data infrastructure, developer tooling, or API company, or another technical product sold to developers or data practitioners.

- Proven track record of building behavior-triggered lifecycle programs that measurably improved activation, conversion, and pipeline at a PLG company with a free trial, free tier, or self-serve signup.

- Analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, run experiments, and make data-driven decisions.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to create engaging content for developers and to work closely with engineers and product partners.

- Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously and meet deadlines.

- Preferred: experience at a company with an open-source product.

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

- Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

Devenere Law Collective is a modern, collaborative law practice serving clients in matters that protect families, businesses, assets, and long-term wealth. independent-contractor classification.

title: 2028 Strategist Fellowship
description:
Note: We are currently collecting resumes for this role; hiring will happen on a rolling basis and begin in earnest in November and December. Details of role may be revised when hiring begins.
Blue Rose Research helps Democrats win elections and advance progressive causes. We work with campaigns in battleground races up and down the ballot and major Democratic, progressive, and advocacy organizations across the country to produce the research and build the tools they use to decide what to say and where to spend.
We produce opinion research at a scale unmatched in politics, put it directly in decision-makers’ hands, and build tools on top of that data that we distribute widely across the progressive ecosystem. You’ll be joining a team of decorated engineers, data scientists, and political analysts who have quietly helped shape how the progressive ecosystem communicates for years.
Blue Rose provides tools and data to all Democratic campaigns; many campaigns are looking for a thought partner who knows how to leverage them. As the 2028 presidential election approaches, we're building out a bench of strategists to support our work with the many campaigns and organizations shaping the primaries and the general that follows. We're looking for a range of skills and backgrounds, but generally want people who are highly proactive, execution-driven, fluent in campaigns and elections, excited to learn, and effective with all levels of campaign stakeholders from junior field organizers to political directors.
This posting is closer to a resume drop than a single job description, and we expect the function, structure, and duration of the role to shift based on the candidate. The role could be full time through the duration of the 2028 cycle, a short-term fellowship, part time, or on a project-basis. We're not looking to keep anyone from ultimately joining a campaign if that's where the work leads, and we expect needs will vary.
In this role, you will:

• Apply Blue Rose's data and tools to turn findings into guidance a non-technical audience can act on

• Determine what a campaign needs, and build credibility quickly with candidates, clients, and senior staff

• Take on ambiguous, open-ended work without waiting to be told what's needed

• Operate in a fast-moving environment where plans change often and answers are needed quickly

• Provide feedback on Blue Rose’s tools and help refine our offerings for 2028

Example backgrounds that could be a fit:

• A comms staffer who has run message discipline or rapid response through a competitive statewide or federal race

• A paid media or digital lead who has managed a significant budget for a campaign, party committee, or PAC, and can incorporate testing results into a media plan

• A campaign operative with relationships across the Democratic consultant, vendor, and staffer ecosystem

• A researcher or analyst who has turned data into recommendations that a principal or client acted on

Qualified candidates ideally have:

• Multiple election cycles of experience in Democratic politics across campaigns, party committees, or political consultancies

• Excellent written and verbal communication, and experience delivering presentations to principals and senior staff that shape what a campaign decides to do

• Strong political instincts and bias towards action to go above and beyond a campaign’s needs

• Comfort picking up new tools and new data quickly, without needing a technical background

• Kindness, humility, and a collaborative spirit

The example backgrounds are non-exhaustive, and we don't expect every applicant to have expertise in every area listed above. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't sound like a perfect fit.
Candidates must be authorized to work lawfully in the United States.
Salary range: Because the format of this role is flexible, compensation will be set based on role, duration, and experience. Expected range for part-time/contract roles is $5,000 - $20,0

title: Contract manager
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity. The Exploration Company builds complex space systems under contracts with government and institutional customers. Programs of this kind evolve: requirements change, design maturity improves, schedules shift, and suppliers and customers request adjustments. Each change must be formally proposed, assessed, negotiated, and recorded in the contract before it can be executed and paid for. As Contract Manager, you will own the change lifecycle for your assigned contracts. You will drive Contract Change Notices (CCNs) from initial request to signature, protect the company's position on scope, cost, and schedule, and keep the contract baseline accurate for the program team. Key responsibilities Own the CCN lifecycle from receipt or initiation through impact assessment, negotiation, approval, and formal issue, with clear ownership and deadlines for every open item. Chase and track open CCNs with customer contracting officers, program managers, and internal stakeholders, and escalate delays that threaten schedule or cash flow. Coordinate impact assessments with engineering, quality, supply chain, and finance, covering technical scope, cost, schedule, risk, and compliance effects. Prepare and negotiate change proposals, including pricing justification, supporting documentation, and changes to terms and conditions. Maintain the contract baseline by recording each approved CCN in the contract register and ensuring the scope, price, milestones, and deliverables reflect the current agreed position. Monitor

- Present your work to senior leaders

title: Principal Technical Consultant - Operational Technology, Network Security
description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD , we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD .
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD .
About AHEAD

AHEAD helps organizations modernize and secure the technology that runs their business. We are building a deeper Operational Technology capability for clients in manufacturing, energy, utilities, healthcare, transportation, and other industries where uptime, safety, and resilience matter. This role helps shape that capability while delivering meaningful client work.
The Role
The Principal Technical Consultant, Operational Technology is a senior technical leader and trusted advisor, and the primary technical resource on OT Assessments and SRDP (strategy, roadmap, design, and plan) engagements. This is a hands-on role. You will lead technical discovery, facilitate workshops, analyze industrial environments, build architecture and roadmap deliverables, guide delivery teams, and present recommendations to client leaders. You should be equally comfortable discussing a PLC network with an automation engineer, an operating model with plant leadership, and investment priorities with a CISO or CIO.
What You Will Do:

Lead OT assessments and advisory engagements

• Serve as the primary technical lead for OT Assessments, OT strategy work, and SRDP workstreams.

• Plan and facilitate discovery workshops, site visits, technical deep dives, and executive working sessions.

• Establish a safe, non-disruptive discovery approach that respects production schedules, safety requirements, and change control.

• Assess the client environment across assets, networks, control systems, dependencies, ownership, and operational constraints, and evaluate maturity across people, process, and technology.

• Identify risks, gaps, single points of failure, and lifecycle concerns affecting security, reliability, visibility, and resilience.

• Produce current-state and future-state architecture views, findings, maturity assessments, and prioritized roadmaps that connect recommendations to business impact, investment, and sequencing.

• Own the technical quality of deliverables and present findings to engineering teams, plant and operations leaders, and executives.

Apply deep OT and cybersecurity expertise

• Analyze OT and ICS architectures spanning PLCs, HMIs, SCADA, DCS, historians, MES, engineering workstations, safety systems, and connected edge environments.

• Evaluate IT/OT connectivity, Purdue-aligned design, zones and conduits, industrial DMZs, segmentation, remote access, and third-party connectivity.

• Assess asset inventory, passive visibility, communication flows, protocol use, legacy platforms, and compensating controls.

• Evaluate identity and access, endpoint protection, vulnerability and patch management, monitoring, incident response, backup, and recovery practices. • Balance security recommendations against safety, availability, performance, maintenance windows, and long OT lifecycles.

• Apply recognized standards including NIST SP 800-82, ISA/IEC 62443, and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, plus applicable regulatory requirements.

• Bring a point of view on secure remote operations, edge computing, industrial wireless and private 5G, cloud-connected OT
